org.w3c.dom.css

接口 CSSUnknownRule

  • 所有超级接口:
    CSSRule

    public interface CSSUnknownRule
extends CSSRule
    The CSSUnknownRule interface represents an at-rule not supported by this user agent.

    See also the Document Object Model (DOM) Level 2 Style Specification.

    从以下版本开始:
    DOM Level 2
